title: Disputes Desk Standard: Level Corrections on Charged Cleaning and Damage Fees
content:
Under Cleaning and Damage Fees, a charged cleaning fee whose assessment is held at a cleaning level whose entry gate does not list the incident category reported, whether the charge stands undisputed, disputed or upheld, is moved down to the highest lower cleaning level whose entry gate lists that category, and the fee standing at that level is recorded with the move.

## Scope

| Question | Answer under this standard |
|---|---|
| Which assessments | charged cleaning fees, whether the charge stands undisputed (charged), disputed or upheld |
| What makes the move due | the cleaning level held has an entry gate that does not list the incident category reported |
| Where the assessment goes | the highest lower cleaning level whose entry gate lists that category |
| What is recorded with the move | the fee standing at the level moved to |

The move changes only the level the assessment is held at and its assessed fee, which becomes the fee standing. The assessment keeps its status, charge date, dispute dates and ledger, and no money is returned to the rider by the move itself.

## Tool card: `correct_upheld_fee_level_42a82f5f`

**Capability.** Moves an assessment whose fee has already been charged (and possibly disputed and upheld) down to a lower fee level and records the fee that stands at that level. Afterwards the assessment lookup shows the new level and the fee standing.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `correct_upheld_fee_level_42a82f5f` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `damage_assessment_id` | the reference number of the charged cleaning or damage fee assessment being corrected, as returned by the assessment lookup | identifier |
| `new_fee_level` | the official fee level the assessment is held at after the correction | exactly one of the six values below |
| `fee_standing` | the fee that stands on the assessment at the new level | US dollars as a decimal number rounded half up to 2 decimal places, for example 64.20 |

Values of `new_fee_level`:

- `Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor)` — it now sits at the minor level for a small spot clean
- `Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate)` — the moderate level for one seat or floor area
- `Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant)` — the significant level for up to two surfaces or a bodily fluid on one surface
- `Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major)` — the major level that needs professional detailing
- `Damage Fee (Interior Repair)` — the interior repair level
- `Damage Fee (Exterior Repair)` — the exterior repair level

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("level_corrected" once the write has landed), `damage_assessment_id` (the assessment reference number), `fee_level` (the official name of the level now held), `fee_standing` (the fee now standing, US dollars with 2 decimal places) and `assessment_status` (the unchanged lifecycle status of the assessment).
